python.description: Python executable: a name on PATH, an absolute path, or a project-relative path

providers.description: Executable of a provider's CLI, by provider id

aligner.description: Program and arguments of the transcript aligner, when it is not the toolkit's own script run by this machine's Python. `python` and `node` resolve to the machine's own.

engine.description: How this machine reaches the engine (editor path, host, port). Passed to adapter commands; never credentials.
